page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Friderici" (first letter unclear, printed as E- or F-like), "tradirur", "THISODORI", "Verle" (initial V/U), "Befluitende", and the Hebrew line before "dat is", which should be checked against the scan. The Hebrew reads roughly as הורה לכהנים; the exact letters are not certain. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. No page number or catchword is printed.
